# Shibumi Shell 0.1.1-beta.4

This prerelease focuses on audio, UI, and lifecycle fixes.

Update an existing source installation:

```bash
cd Shibumi-Shell
git pull --ff-only
./scripts/shibumi-suite update --yes
```

> AUR publication remains pending because registration is currently unavailable.

## What changed

- Switch active audio outputs without stopping the current playback stream
- Control output, application, and microphone volume from one consistent mixer
- Select and inspect storage devices through the expanded Storage panel
- Use the Pacman workspace style with corrected animation, scaling, and workspace visibility
- Browse bounded Carousel picker previews without unbounded image decoding

## Fixes in beta.4

- Keep stock Omarchy widgets out of Shibumi layouts during activation
- Protect saved Shibumi profiles from mixed-layout snapshots
- Keep the Control Center open while changing widget activation state
- Restore V1 panel interaction, network rendering, and variant switching stability
- Normalize AI usage percentages before rendering usage fills
- Keep device labels, audio profiles, mixer levels, and volume spacing stable
- Remove unreliable GPU process telemetry while retaining device diagnostics
- Prevent the Update Center open state from freezing

Full Changelog: [`v0.1.1-beta.3...v0.1.1-beta.4`](https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/compare/v0.1.1-beta.3...v0.1.1-beta.4)
